title: How a Tractor Maker Ended Up Building the Countach
description:
He did not come from racing. He did not come from a famous car family. He came from a farm town in northern Italy, he repaired military trucks, and he built tractors. Then, in nineteen sixty-three, he started a car company, and eleven years later his engineers launched the Lamborghini Countach. This is how a tractor maker ended up building one of the most famous supercars ever made. The usual version of this story has a single angry moment with Enzo Ferrari. The real record, according to our sources, is more complicated, and in places uncertain. We will tell it in order, say what is documented, and mark clearly what is legend. Every fact comes from a published source, listed in the description. Where we do the maths, we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
